description: This Java class defines an adapter (PolicyErrorResponseAdapter) for mapping PolicyErrorResponse objects to and from an Adaptable representation within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It provides methods to create the adapter, build topic paths, and build error responses, facilitating integration with Ditto policies.

classes.name: PolicyErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for converting PolicyErrorResponse objects to and from an adaptable protocol format within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of PolicyErrorResponseAdapter with specified header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Builds a TopicPathBuilder based on the entity ID from the provided PolicyErrorResponse.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyErrorResponse object from a topic path, exception, and headers.
